notes: Not from a Swift test — ConfigManager's Codable-backed AppConfig actually drops fields it doesn't declare (Swift's synthesized Decodable silently ignores unrecognized keys), which is exactly the destructive behavior msc2-engineering.md §7 calls out for server.properties and this phase's design note (rolling-plan.md P3.7) generalizes away from. This fixture pins down the corrected behavior instead: load, mutate one known field (tps), save, and confirm 'futureField' - a field this code never looks at - is still present afterward. Operating on serde_json::Value rather than a fixed struct is what makes this true for free, without a per-schema 'unknown fields' bucket.
